label: Google Cloud files
about: What to look for in IAM bindings, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, app.yaml and cloudbuild.yaml. Files only.
tested: One fixture (Terraform for Google, app.yaml, cloudbuild.yaml), real model, 3 runs: the first two replies were refused whole for command words in prose (the note was reworded); the third passed (36 s, $0.16), 7 of 7 planted found (allUsers bindings, owner role, force_destroy, public access prevention, deletion protection, two secrets). NOT tested: Cloud Run service YAML against a model (file detection is unit-tested only), IAM policy JSON, a real project. Not reviewed by a Google Cloud specialist.
